title: potentilla norvegica f. labradorica
intro: Potentilla norvegica f. labradorica, commonly known as Tott Hill cinquefoil, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and reduce the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla norvegica f. labradorica are attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of bacteria and its antihistamine effects, which may help alleviate allergic reactions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
